bullets.text: AI-Powered Production Studio Launched - **Luma** partners with **Wonder Project** to revolutionise video production with AI tools.
Apple's Marathon Events Announced - **Apple** promotes health products ahead of the TCS London Marathon with engaging activities.
Criminal Record Returns to Apple TV - The acclaimed London crime thriller is set to premiere its second season next week.
Motorola Razr Fold Pre-Orders Open - The innovative foldable phone is set to launch in the UK on May 6.
New AI Assistant for Mac - **Perplexity** launches a personal AI assistant feature for Mac subscribers.
Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Camera Feature - Production begins on a new variable aperture lens for the upcoming iPhone model.
Sequoia Raises $7B for AI Investments - The venture firm aims to expand its late-stage investing strategy in AI.
Factory Valued at $1.5B - Startup **Factory** raises $150 million to develop AI coding solutions for enterprises.
Netflix Co-Founder to Leave Board - **Reed Hastings** steps down from Netflix's board after nearly 30 years.
Google's AI Mode Enhancements - **Google** introduces a side-by-side browsing experience with AI Mode for Chrome.
